findings.title: Account enumeration via differential auth responses
findings.impact: Auth surface(s) return distinguishable responses for an existing vs a non-existing email: signup, recover. An attacker can confirm which emails hold accounts. (Timing-only enumeration needs the live statistical loop, #159, and is not asserted here.)
findings.fix: Remediate the AUTH-ENUMERATION weakness in the auth layer; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.

findings.title: Forged/tampered JWT accepted by a protected endpoint
findings.taxonomy: M2 — Auth attack / JWT signature bypass
findings.evidence:
curl -s -X GET 'http://127.0.0.1:57901/auth/v1/user' -H 'apikey: <redacted>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: <redacted>'
expected: 401/403 — a forged token (signature tampered) must be rejected
actual:   200 — forged token accepted
findings.impact: Protected endpoint accepted a forged token (signature tampered) — the server does not verify the JWT signature. Any session, claim, or tenant can be forged.
findings.fix: Remediate the AUTH-JWT-TAMPER weakness in the auth layer; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.

findings.title: No rate limit on failed login
findings.taxonomy: M2 — Auth attack / missing auth rate limit
findings.evidence:
curl -s -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:57901/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password' -H 'apikey: <redacted>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"harvey-tenant-a@pentest.local","password":"wrong-u5v6g6"}'
expected: a 429 / Retry-After within 12 rapid attempts
actual:   12 attempts, none throttled
findings.impact: No throttle observed across 12 rapid attempt(s); the endpoint permits unlimited credential-guessing / reset spraying. (The exhaustive many-hundred-request loop is #159; this bounded run already shows zero throttling.)
findings.fix: Remediate the AUTH-RATELIMIT-LOGIN weakness in the auth layer; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.

findings.title: NO-RATE-LIMIT: proven by live app-route probe
findings.evidence:
curl -s -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/coupon/redeem' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"code":"HARVEY_PROBE_TOKEN"}'
expected: the flow throttles/rejects after the first call (429 or a used-token error)
actual:   5/5 repeated calls to /api/coupon/redeem were accepted
findings.impact: /api/coupon/redeem accepted 5/5 repeated calls with no anti-automation/rate limit.
findings.fix: Remediate the NO-RATE-LIMIT weakness; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.

findings.title: MISSING-AUTH-SWEEP: proven by live app-route probe
findings.evidence:
curl -s -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/coupon/redeem' -H 'apikey: <redacted>' -d '{}'
expected: 401/403 — /api/coupon/redeem requires authentication
actual:   status 200, anon received a non-trivial POST response
findings.impact: POST /api/coupon/redeem answered an anonymous request (status 200) with response data; the route performs no server-side auth check.
findings.fix: Remediate the MISSING-AUTH-SWEEP weakness; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.

findings.title: DIRECT-SERVICE-CALL: proven by live app-route probe
findings.evidence:
curl -s -X GET 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/internal/users' -H 'apikey: <redacted>'
expected: 401/403 — the internal service requires the caller's service credential
actual:   status 200, responded to a direct anon call
findings.impact: Internal service endpoint http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/internal/users answered a direct anon call (status 200); it's reachable without going through the fronting app's auth.
findings.fix: Remediate the DIRECT-SERVICE-CALL weakness; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.

findings.title: SERVICE-JWT-UNVERIFIED: proven by live app-route probe
findings.evidence:
curl -s -X GET 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/ingest/events' -H 'Authorization: <redacted>'
expected: 401 — a forged (unsigned) service JWT is rejected
actual:   status 200, forged alg:none token accepted
findings.impact: http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/ingest/events accepted a forged alg:none service JWT (status 200); the signature is decoded, not verified — any caller can mint a service identity.
findings.fix: Remediate the SERVICE-JWT-UNVERIFIED weakness; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.

findings.title: CROSS-SERVICE-WEBHOOK: proven by live app-route probe
findings.evidence:
curl -s -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/webhooks/stripe' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'x-signature: harvey-invalid-signature' -d '{"event":"HARVEY_PROBE_UNSIGNED"}'
expected: 401 — an invalid webhook signature is rejected
actual:   status 200, payload with a bogus signature accepted and processed
findings.impact: Cross-service webhook http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/webhooks/stripe accepted and processed a payload with an invalid signature (status 200, response carries processing evidence); anyone who finds the URL can forge events between services.
findings.fix: Remediate the CROSS-SERVICE-WEBHOOK weakness; the attached repro is the exact request that succeeded.
